text:
Predicates:
Season(x) ::: x is a season.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
LovesMost(x, y) ::: x loves season y the most.
WantsLongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Favorite(x, y) ::: y is the favorite season of x.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WantsLongVacation(x) → LovesMost(x, summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
Favorite(emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
Favorite(mia, y) → y ≠ summer ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
WantsLongVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
Favorite(james, summer) ::: James's favorite season is summer.
